tidur-berkualitas.p1: Sleep is not merely rest time; it is an essential process in which the body repairs tissue, consolidates memory, and balances hormones. Good sleep quality directly affects immunity, mood, and concentration.
tidur-berkualitas.h1: The Impact of Poor Sleep Quality
tidur-berkualitas.p2: Long-term sleep deprivation is linked to a higher risk of hypertension, type 2 diabetes, and reduced immune function. It also worsens anxiety and daily productivity.
tidur-berkualitas.p3: Set consistent sleep and wake times, avoid caffeine in the afternoon, and create a dark and cool room. Also limit screen exposure for at least one hour before bed.
tidur-berkualitas.p4: If sleep problems last more than a few weeks and disrupt your activities, consult a doctor for further evaluation.

mitos-nutrisi.p1: Nutrition information spreads easily without verification. As a result, many myths are believed despite lacking scientific evidence. Let's clear up a few of them.
mitos-nutrisi.p2: The idea that carbohydrates are always bad or that eating at night automatically adds weight is not entirely true. What matters most is the quality of food and overall portions.
mitos-nutrisi.p3: Focus on a balanced diet rich in vegetables, fruits, protein, and whole grains. No single food alone determines your health.
mitos-nutrisi.p4: Consult your specific nutritional needs, especially if you have certain medical conditions, so recommendations are more targeted.

cegah-demam-berdarah.p1: Dengue fever is transmitted through the bite of Aedes aegypti mosquitoes that breed in clean standing water. The most effective prevention starts at home.
cegah-demam-berdarah.p2: Drain water storage containers, seal them tightly, and recycle used items that can hold water. Add plus steps such as using mosquito repellent and keeping larvae-eating fish.
cegah-demam-berdarah.p3: Watch for sudden high fever, muscle pain, rash, and low platelets. Seek medical attention promptly if these signs appear, especially in children.
cegah-demam-berdarah.p4: Early detection and proper treatment greatly reduce the risk of complications. Don't delay consultation if symptoms worsen.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Can't find the answer? Feel free to contact us.

q1.q: Do I need to make an appointment before coming?
q1.a: For your comfort and to avoid long queues, we strongly recommend booking in advance via the form or WhatsApp.

q2.q: How do I make an appointment?
q2.a: You can fill in the appointment form on this website or contact us directly via WhatsApp. Our team will confirm your schedule.

q3.q: Do you accept certain insurance plans?
q3.a: Please contact us first for the latest information on available insurance partnerships.

q4.a: Yes, online consultation is available via telemedicine. Technical details will be provided upon scheduling.

q5.q: What is the estimated consultation fee?
q5.a: The consultation fee varies depending on the type of service and practice location. Details will be provided upon confirmation.

q6.a: Yes, consultations can be conducted in both Indonesian and English.

q7.q: What is the procedure for a medical certificate?
q7.a: A medical certificate is issued after a brief physical examination. Please inform us of your needs when booking.

q8.a: As a general practitioner, we accept patients of all ages, including children, for general health complaints.
